statement: Exact typed reduction for every hard maximum-witness graph G: because R_A is integral, the outer gate R_A<=S_m is exactly R_A<=floor(S_m), so the irrational remainder supplies no integral carrier capacity. If the graph-realizable low-edge/high-anchor exchange graph has matching rank at least ceil(Phi(n,e)), its matched outputs give the direct distinct-colour C7-compatible exit. Otherwise a carrier proof must construct previously unused actual carriers Z whose legal neighbourhoods eliminate every augmented Hall deficit |T|-|N(T)|, with a global ownership map preventing reuse across circuits. Merely producing delta carriers is sufficient only for universal adjacency; Hall and alternating-path bookkeeping do not create Z.

precise separation between graph-realizable exchange exit and carrier creation
necessary and sufficient Hall condition after actual carriers are constructed
